note: The trekking plan (Manu, 2026-11-13): ~12 trails per country, 3-4 drawings per trail. slot = the helper thread that owns the trail. status: todo (only planned), draft (data written, not yet checked), checked (coordinates checked on OSM, geo built, numbers within 30% of the published ones), drawn (every scene done). scenes: the key points to draw; reuse = an existing scene that already shows that point (don't redraw it, but look at it: if it shows something else, draw a new one). 2026-11-14 (Manu: treks at par with trips, 8 countries PE CL AR IS NZ JP VN NA): +143 tier-A top treks as todo; slots group ~6 trails each. tier B (OSM long tail) is not planned here: it is generated (tools/trails/osm_tail.py).
